Tony Stewart.learned: Tony Stewart is a paramedic at the Willow Clinic who loves the rush of emergency calls and the creative glow of neon street art. He is always looking for ways to bring calm, quick thinking and a splash of color to Smallville.
Tony Stewart.currently: Tony Stewart is studying for his paramedic certification exams and sketching a neon mural he hopes to paint on the wall behind the Willow Clinic. Tony is also planning a community emergency-preparedness workshop with his flatmate Dr. Chad Kibler and Hua Lai, while checking in on his regular calls, Sam and Jennifer Moore.
Tony Stewart.lifestyle: Tony Stewart goes to bed around 11pm, wakes up around 6am, eats dinner around 8pm.

Cledith Hardin.learned: Cledith Hardin is a college lecturer who teaches literature and art history at Oak Hill College. He loves weaving visual studies and cultural criticism into his classes, and he unwinds by tending his meticulous rose bed while his cat naps among his scattered paintbrushes.
Cledith Hardin.currently: This week Cledith is drafting a National Endowment for the Humanities grant proposal late into the night to document mid-century American visual culture. He is also mentoring Ayesha Khan and Klaus Mueller on their final essays while planning a cross-disciplinary program with his colleague Mei Lin.
Cledith Hardin.lifestyle: Cledith Hardin goes to bed around midnight, wakes up around 6am, eats dinner around 6:30pm.

Eugene Johnson.learned: Eugene Johnson is a barista at Hobbs Cafe who loves connecting with customers and pushing himself to improve. He is always looking for ways to turn his STEM education and retail experience into a career in tech.
Eugene Johnson.currently: Eugene Johnson is studying for an IT certification in the evenings while picking up extra shifts for Isabella Rodriguez at Hobbs Cafe. He is also planning a weekend cookout with his roommate Sharon Antle and his friend Maria Lopez.
Eugene Johnson.lifestyle: Eugene Johnson goes to bed around 11pm, awakes up around 5am, eats dinner around 6pm.

David Puskar.learned: David Puskar is a chef who loves turning hearty Midwestern comfort food into edible art, and he works as the night cook at Arthur Burton's Rose and Crown Pub. He is always chasing perfection in the kitchen, finding calm in herb-scented meditation and the click of a camera shutter.
David Puskar.currently: David is testing German-Polish fusion recipes this week for a tasting menu he hopes to pitch to Arthur Burton at the Rose and Crown Pub. Between shifts, he photographs his plated dishes for a future bistro portfolio and swaps honest feedback with Carlos Gomez, a regular at the bar.
David Puskar.lifestyle: David Puskar goes to bed around 3am, awakes up around 10am, eats dinner around 4pm.

Ana Abad.learned: Ana Abad is a waitress at the Rose and Crown Pub who loves bringing people together through food, art, and community. She is always sketching late-night ideas for the Dominican-inspired café she dreams of opening.
Ana Abad.currently: Ana Abad is picking up extra evening shifts for Arthur Burton at the Rose and Crown Pub while finishing her hospitality-management coursework and carefully budgeting for her future café. She is also trading recipe ideas with Abigail Chen and Hailey Johnson, who agreed to taste-test her plantain dishes.
Ana Abad.lifestyle: Ana Abad goes to bed around 1am, awakes up around 9am, eats dinner around 4pm.

Dalton Robinson.learned: Dalton Robinson is a delivery driver who keeps Harvey Oak Supply Store, the Willows Market and Hobbs Cafe stocked, and he loves pairing meticulous route planning with his lifelong passion for blues and jazz records. He is always looking for ways to bring an artist’s eye to the everyday rhythm of Smallville’s streets.
Dalton Robinson.currently: Dalton is working with Tom Moreno and Carmen Ortiz to fine-tune this week’s delivery routes between the Willows Market and Hobbs Cafe. He is also studying for a supply-chain management certification in hopes of moving into a fleet-manager position.
Dalton Robinson.lifestyle: Dalton goes to bed around 9pm, wakes up around 5am, eats dinner around 6pm.

Job Amely.learned: Job Amely is a seasoned handyman and plumber who has kept Smallville's buildings in working order for over 25 years, fixing pipes and roofs everywhere from the cafe and pub to the clinic and town hall. He loves pairing his technical craftsmanship with an artistic flair, and he is happiest when a repair turns into a chance to mentor a younger worker or share stories over a home-cooked meal.
Job Amely.currently: This week Job is replacing burst pipes at Tom Moreno's house and patching the Moore family's roof before the next storm rolls in, with another repair call lined up from Isabella Rodriguez. He is also drafting a preventive-maintenance plan he hopes will earn him a promotion to senior maintenance supervisor, and planning a weekend fishing trip with his housemate, the town's delivery driver.
Job Amely.lifestyle: Job goes to bed around 10pm, awakes up around 5:30am, eats dinner around 7pm. He starts his repair rounds at 7am, takes a lunch break around noon, and wraps up his workday by 4pm.

Jeanne Love.learned: Jeanne Love is a seasoned automotive service technician who runs a small garage in Smallville. She loves meticulously restoring old cars and mentoring newcomers to the trade.
Jeanne Love.currently: Jeanne is rebuilding the transmission in Tom Moreno's pickup while doing a full tune-up on Ryan Park's sedan this week. She is also studying in the evenings for her ASE Master Technician certification exams.
Jeanne Love.lifestyle: Jeanne goes to bed around 9:30pm, wakes up around 5:30am, eats dinner around 6pm.

Eugene Middlebrooks.learned: Eugene Middlebrooks is a junior accountant at town hall who loves keeping the books for Smallville's shops and finding the story hidden in the numbers. He is always looking for ways to turn his knack for balancing ledgers into help for community projects.
Eugene Middlebrooks.currently: Eugene is reconciling the cafe's and grocery's quarterly accounts while Yuriko Yamamoto mentors him through his CPA study plan. He is also teaming up with Ryan Park to organize a weekend fundraiser at the park for the new clinic.
Eugene Middlebrooks.lifestyle: Eugene Middlebrooks goes to bed around 11pm, awakes up around 7am, eats dinner around 7pm.

Jason O'Brien.learned: Jason O'Brien is a chaplain and counsellor who loves to explore the dialogue between theology and the arts. He is always looking for ways to weave storytelling, watercolor painting, and classical piano into his pastoral care at the new clinic and his weekly listening hour at Johnson Park.
Jason O'Brien.currently: Jason is writing a book about the dialogue between theology and contemporary visual art while planning a regional interfaith arts symposium. Jason is also hosting his weekly listening hour at Johnson Park, where Jane Moreno and Klaus Mueller each seek his advice.
Jason O'Brien.lifestyle: Jason O'Brien goes to bed around 10pm, wakes up around 5am, eats dinner around 6pm.

Jenny Rivera.learned: Jenny Rivera is a fitness trainer who leads high-energy morning classes in Johnson Park. She loves blending salsa and cumbia rhythms into her workouts and always hoards an extra jar of salsa sauce for late-night cravings.
Jenny Rivera.currently: Jenny Rivera is choreographing her signature SaborFit routine to debut at Saturday's class in Johnson Park. Jenny is also training Wolfgang Schulz and Mei Lin toward their fitness goals while planning a salsa night at the pub with Francisco Lopez.
Jenny Rivera.lifestyle: Jenny Rivera goes to bed around 10pm, awakes up around 5am, eats dinner around 7pm. She teaches her first class in Johnson Park at 6am, then trains clients through the late morning.

Nair Viggiani.learned: Nair Viggiani is a musician and piano teacher who gives lessons from his home studio in Smallville and plays weekends at Hobbs Cafe. He loves fusing the traditional Mexican folk songs of his childhood with indie melodies, and he never passes up a crate of vintage vinyl or a spontaneous hike.
Nair Viggiani.currently: Nair is recording demos for his debut album and preparing his student Eddy Lin for an upcoming piano recital. Isabella Rodriguez has also booked him for a Saturday set at Hobbs Cafe, so he is rehearsing a setlist that weaves together Spanish and English songs.
Nair Viggiani.lifestyle: Nair goes to bed around midnight, wakes up around 8am, eats dinner around 7pm.

Victor Rosales.learned: Victor Rosales is a retired engineer who loves precise woodworking, mentoring young engineers, and keeping his family's Mexican traditions alive through cooking and music. He now volunteers at the Smallville college, where he guides engineering students with the same structural analysis rigor he honed over three decades of design work.
Victor Rosales.currently: Victor is finishing a hand-carved trellis for his neighbour Amilcar Rosales's garden while rehearsing traditional songs for the family's Día de los Muertos gathering. He is also meeting his old friend Sam Moore at the cafe to plan weekly one-on-one mentoring sessions for at-risk youth at the college.
Victor Rosales.lifestyle: Victor Rosales goes to bed around 9:30pm, wakes up around 6am, eats dinner around 5:30pm, and fills his retirement days with solitary morning walks in the park, woodworking in his home workshop, and afternoons volunteering at the college.

Amber Williamson.learned: Amber Williamson is a retired storyteller in her sixties who loves telling tales to children and growing flowers in Johnson Park. She believes every neighbour has a story worth hearing.
Amber Williamson.currently: Amber Williamson is planning a Saturday story hour at the Oak Hill College library with Andrea Lovetro and hopes Jennifer Moore will paint backdrops for it. She also visits Sam Moore for tea most afternoons.
Amber Williamson.lifestyle: Amber Williamson goes to bed around 9pm, awakes up around 6am, eats dinner around 5pm.

Diane Bosse.learned: Diane Bosse is a hairdresser who owns a small salon in Smallville and loves perfecting advanced color work like balayage and foiling. She is always looking for ways to make her services more environmentally conscious and to give local artists a place to shine.
Diane Bosse.currently: Diane Bosse is researching organic product suppliers and sketching plans to turn her salon into a boutique space with a small art gallery. This week she has back-to-back appointments with regulars Jane Moreno and Mei Lin, and she is quietly worrying about getting Isabella Rodriguez's color exactly right.
Diane Bosse.lifestyle: Diane Bosse goes to bed around 11pm, wakes up around 7am, eats dinner around 8pm. She works at her salon from 9am to 6pm Tuesday through Saturday, using Sundays and Mondays for planning, supply runs and rest.
